main_body: Open wooden rack: a top beam with four weapons standing in it, a middle rail, and a bottom shelf, all on side posts
top_band: Middle column: light tan band at rows ~8-11 (top of the upper beam), then a darker brown front face at rows 12-13. The bottom shelf repeats this with a light tan top at rows ~24-27 over a darker front at rows 28-30.
evidence: The upper beam and the bottom shelf each show a clearly lighter horizontal top band of about 4 rows. A darker front face sits below each band, with a step and a darker shadow row under the edge. The middle rail has a light top edge, though it is thin. The posts run down behind and under the horizontal members. This matches the guide's 'seat: top 5 + legs' pattern, so the horizontal members show top faces and the drawing is 3/4.

style.evidence: The wood has about 4 flat steps (light tan, mid tan, orange-brown, dark brown), and the metal blades have 3 greys. The outlines are dark brown, which is acceptable. The posts, beams and blades are large flat fills with almost no grain, knots, nail dots or per-surface speckle. Most tiles carry only 3-5 colours, well below the reference stall and well, which have rich texture and many tones. It reads thinner and flatter next to them.
